arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-01' AND date < '2020-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated from 1 October 2019 through 31 January 2020. The data stops at 31 October 2019, so in practice the count covers October 2019 only.
assumptions: The data only runs from 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so nothing after 31 October 2019 can be counted. The result covers 1–31 October 2019.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, and including those with negative amounts or errors.
